Round 151 (V-2a, Studio fonts) is a **FAIL, but only on Low findings**. All 14 browser rows ran at both viewports. 11 pass, 2 fail on Low findings, and 1 sub-check (fake-Bearer 403) is blocked because there's no backend in the cloud. No source changed while I was testing.

**What works:**
- **Fonts render as intended.** I checked the font Chromium actually draws with, not just the CSS:
  - **Instrument Sans:** the UI text and the Export dialog.
  - **IBM Plex Mono:** the time, BPM, dB readouts and From/To.
  - **Noto Sans Georgian:** the Georgian library names.
- **Studio fonts stay on `/studio-lab`.** The `/`, `/cart` and `/login` pages make no Studio font requests and keep their existing fonts and colours. On `/studio-lab` the font stylesheet loads exactly once.
- **Layout:** nothing moves vertically, no element appears or disappears, and two runs give identical boxes. B's predicted horizontal moves match to the pixel (29/29 keys at 1440, 27/27 at 1280). The largest move is 9 px, and each one comes from narrower text in the same row.
- **Nothing gets cut off,** including BPM 123.45 (4 px to spare), volume at min and max, and the master peak in its red over state (+29.6).
- **Contrast:** no new failures; the minimum is still 4.57.
- **Blocked Google Fonts:** the Studio still loads in system fonts and works, with no errors.
- **Basic functions:** play, drag and undo, BPM, search, Export, the marker menu and Loop all still work.
- **Sign-in protection is not bypassed:** the demo opens without an account, `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no audio, and the token endpoint returns 401.

**Findings for B (all Low):**
- **C-R151-1, conflicting rule.** The shortcut-hint line at the bottom shrinks by 119 px, exactly as B predicted. The layout tool classes that line as a panel, though, and B's own rule says panels must stay within ±1 px. It is really just a line of text, so this probably needs B's ruling rather than a code change.
- **C-R151-2, cramped separators.** The new font makes " · " 5 px wide instead of 9 px under Inter, so text like "Space·Home·Ctrl+E" and "WAV·24-bit·48 kHz" runs together. This round caused it, so by B's §7 table it goes to a fix-up round. I measured it only on headless Linux; Windows and macOS may look slightly different.
- **C-R151-3, cosmetic.** In "−∞" the "∞" comes from a fallback font because Plex Mono doesn't include that character. It looks acceptable at 12 px.

For B to decide in the next typography step (V-2b): library durations and the library playhead are timecodes but still use the sans font.

Typeface choice is a CZABA brand decision with no Ableton source, so Ableton parity doesn't apply. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. One first page load hit the known cold-start error and was replaced once.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-151.md
- c-round-151.json
- c-round-151/ (tools, out, shots)
